brief: @buildthis.bisks.net find every single major phone's dimensions you can online starting from the original iphone, then build a little physics toy where i can throw around a big pile of one of every phone with click and drag in 3d. make sure theyre labeled
note: researched real mm dimensions for 147 phones (original 2007 iPhone → 2026 lineup, every Galaxy S/Note, every Pixel/Nexus, plus the historic weirdos) and dropped them all into a real cannon-es physics tray — grab one and throw it.
